summary: Email notifications now work with Microsoft 365 / Graph without an SMTP From address; tags show on tickets, can be changed after triage and can be limited to departments and categories; Nodemailer and Zod are updated for security advisories. Includes one additive database migration that runs automatically.
upgrade_notes: Rehearsal manifest for upgrade testing. Point a test installation at it with COMPDESK_UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL; never at production. Back up PostgreSQL, private attachments, uploaded branding, and the private configuration volume together before upgrading.
